Play-by-play in the ggbasket layout

Source: R/pbp.R
pbp.Rd

Every game-level function in ggbasket reads one play-by-play layout: one row per event, in game order, with

Usage

pbp_from_espn(x, league = "NBA", period_length = 12, ot_length = 5)

pbp_from_euroleague(
  pbp_json,
  points_json = NULL,
  season,
  game_code,
  league = "EuroLeague",
  period_length = 10,
  ot_length = 5
)

fetch_euroleague_pbp(season, games = NULL, shots = TRUE, pause = 1)

Arguments

x

ESPN play-by-play, one or more games (a data frame as returned by hoopR::load_nba_pbp() or hoopR::espn_nba_pbp()).

league

League label.

period_length, ot_length

Minutes in a regular period and in overtime.

pbp_json, points_json

One game's responses from the EuroLeague live API: PlayByPlay and (optional, for shot locations) Points, parsed by jsonlite::fromJSON().

season

Season start year (2024 = 2024/25).

game_code

The game's code within the season.

games

Game codes to download (default: every played game of the season).

shots

Also download shot locations?

pause

Seconds to wait between requests (the API rate-limits).

Value

A tibble in the ggbasket play-by-play layout.

Details

  • league, season, game_id, date, hometeam, awayteam;

  • period, periodTime (seconds elapsed in the period), totalTime (seconds elapsed in the game), playlength (seconds since the previous event);

  • team (team of player), oppTeam, event_type ("shot", "miss", "free throw", "rebound", "turnover", "foul", "sub", "timeout", "jump ball", "start of period", "end of period", "violation", "unknown"), rebound ("offensive"/"defensive"), result ("made"/"missed"), ShotType ("2P", "3P", "FT"), points (scored on the event);

  • player, assist, steal, block (the last two are players of oppTeam), entered, left;

  • home_score, away_score after the event;

  • x, y shot location in metres from the hoop centre, and original_x, original_y in tenths of feet;

  • a1-a5 (away) and h1-h5 (home): the players on court;

  • description.

This is a superset of BasketballAnalyzeR's PbP, so data prepared with PbPmanipulation() also works. pbp_from_espn() converts NBA (and WNBA, college) play-by-play from ESPN as served by hoopR::load_nba_pbp(); pbp_from_euroleague() converts the EuroLeague's official live API, which fetch_euroleague_pbp() downloads.

Who is on court is not part of either feed. add_lineups() rebuilds it from substitutions: a player who acts in a period before being subbed in started that period. A player who plays a whole period without touching the ball or being substituted is carried over from the previous period.

Examples

head(pbp_games[, c("game_id", "period", "periodTime", "team", "event_type", "player", "points")])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#>   game_id   period periodTime team  event_type player          points
#>   <chr>      <int>      <dbl> <chr> <chr>      <chr>            <int>
#> 1 401766128      1          0 IND   jump ball  Myles Turner        NA
#> 2 401766128      1         16 IND   shot       Andrew Nembhard      2
#> 3 401766128      1         31 OKC   miss       Jalen Williams       0
#> 4 401766128      1         35 IND   rebound    Aaron Nesmith       NA
#> 5 401766128      1         43 OKC   foul       Luguentz Dort       NA
#> 6 401766128      1         49 IND   miss       Myles Turner         0
